Corollary
[Compact-set bound for $\widetilde L_i$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0157 ↗ lem:chow-iv-type-a-l-distance-upper-bound 1. ch30:30.5\group Singular-Time Reduced Distance

Under the hypotheses of Lemma 1, for every compact $K\subset \mathcal M_\infty $, every $\varepsilon >0$, and every $t_0<\omega _\infty -\varepsilon $, the functions $\widetilde L_i$ are uniformly bounded on $K\times [t_0,\omega _\infty -\varepsilon ]$ for all sufficiently large $i$.
